title: Bean and cheese quesadilla strips
summary: Mashed black beans and melty cheese in a soft tortilla, cut into easy-to-hold strips.
texture: Soft and melty, cut into strips about the width of two fingers. Mash the beans so there are no whole beans.
ingredients: 2 tbsp no-salt-added black beans, rinsed and mashed
2 tbsp grated mild cheddar or mozzarella
steps: Spread the mashed beans over half the tortilla. Sprinkle with cumin and cheese.
Fold the tortilla in half and press gently.
Cook in a dry nonstick pan over medium-low heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden and the cheese has melted.
Cool for a few minutes, then cut into strips.
choking: Mash the beans well: whole beans can be a choking risk for young toddlers.
Cool before serving; melted cheese stays very hot.

allergens.name: Wheat
allergens.note: Tortillas are made from wheat (choose corn tortillas if your child avoids wheat).

storage: Best fresh. Leftover strips keep 1 day in the fridge; reheat in a dry pan.
tips: Add mashed avocado or a spoon of plain yogurt for dipping.
Mashed sweet potato instead of beans makes a sweeter version.
